summary: Ghana offers the only formal immigration program in the world designed specifically for the African diaspora: the Right of Abode. African Americans and Afro-Caribbeans with proven African ancestry can obtain indefinite residence rights. This directory covers 13 verified immigration lawyers and solicitors in Accra who specialize in Right of Abode, GIPC investor permits, and naturalization for diaspora clients.
contextNote: Ghana's Right of Abode program is a creation of the Ghana Immigration Service under the Ghana Immigration Act 2000 (Act 573). It is the only immigration instrument in sub-Saharan Africa that explicitly recognizes the African diaspora's claim to return. A good Right of Abode lawyer understands not just the application process but the documentation challenge: slavery destroyed most genealogical records for African Americans, so experienced lawyers use DNA ancestry results, historical records, and affidavit-based alternative documentation strategies.

firms.name: Diaspora Legal Ghana
firms.description: Accra's most prominent Right of Abode specialist for African American and Afro-Caribbean clients. The firm built its practice around the Year of Return movement and has since processed hundreds of ROA applications. Notably, they have a documented process for clients who cannot provide traditional genealogical documentation due to the destruction of ancestral records during slavery, using DNA ancestry results alongside affidavits and community evidence. Free 30-minute initial consultations. 4.8 Google rating.
highlights: Right of Abode for African Americans without traditional documentation

firms.name: Kwame Mensah & Associates
firms.description: Full-service immigration solicitors with a dedicated diaspora practice group. Handles both Right of Abode applications and GIPC investor permit routes, making them useful for diaspora members who also want to invest in Ghana. Known for guiding clients through the Ghana Investment Promotion Centre registration process alongside immigration paperwork. USD-denominated consultation fees for international clients. Active YouTube presence explaining the ROA process in plain English.
highlights: Dual ROA and investor permit expertise

firms.name: Ghana Diaspora Law
firms.description: Online-first immigration law firm founded by a British-Ghanaian solicitor with specific experience serving UK and North American diaspora clients. Specializes purely in immigration matters with no property or commercial law crossover, which means deep focus on the ROA and naturalization pathways. Confirmed Google Ads targeting diaspora clients searching for Right of Abode help. Fully remote process with document upload portal.

firms.name: Accra Immigration Law Centre
firms.description: One of the larger immigration-focused practices in Accra, handling the full spectrum from student permits through to naturalization. The diaspora practice arm handles Right of Abode applications with a structured process developed through years of Year of Return client intake. Good choice for clients who need both immigration and business registration support simultaneously, as they coordinate with business lawyers in-house.

firms.name: Nkrumah & Partners
firms.description: Boutique Accra firm known specifically in the Right of Abode and citizenship community. Handles DNA ancestry documentation pathways for African Americans who lack traditional genealogical records. Has represented clients from the United States, UK, and Caribbean in ROA matters. Active on social media with educational content about the Right of Abode process. Instagram presence with 3,000+ followers in the diaspora community.

firms.name: Agyemang Law Group
firms.description: Investor-focused immigration solicitors whose core client base is diaspora entrepreneurs setting up businesses in Ghana. Specialist in GIPC investor permits, which require a minimum capital injection and business registration with the Registrar General. Well-suited for diaspora clients who want to invest and live in Ghana simultaneously via the investor permit route. Also handles Right of Abode for clients who prefer that pathway.

firms.name: Ofori Legal
firms.description: Mid-size Accra solicitors firm with an active immigration department serving diaspora clients from the US, UK, and Canada. Known for clear upfront pricing and a structured client intake process that maps immigration goals to the best-fit program. Good choice for clients who want honest advice about whether Right of Abode or the investor permit route makes more practical sense for their situation.

firms.name: Boateng Chambers
firms.description: Full-service immigration chambers offering the complete range of diaspora immigration services. Handles Right of Abode, GIPC investor permits, naturalization after Right of Abode qualification, and work permits. The firm has explicit experience with the naturalization pathway that follows Right of Abode, which is valuable for diaspora members who want eventual Ghanaian citizenship rather than just indefinite stay rights.

firms.name: Mensah & Co Solicitors
firms.description: Established Accra firm with a broad practice covering corporate, commercial, and immigration matters. Handles immigration as part of a larger corporate client service rather than as a diaspora specialty. Appropriate for clients relocating for corporate employment who need immigration tied to a business structure.

firms.name: Dugan-Boateng Legal
firms.description: Commercial-focused legal practice with an immigration department primarily serving corporate expatriate clients. Handles GIPC investor permits and work permits as part of business incorporation packages. Not diaspora-focused but well-regarded in the corporate sector.

firms.name: Ghana Immigration Solutions
firms.description: Immigration consultancy and legal advisory firm handling permit renewals, investor permits, and document authentication. Not a Right of Abode specialist, but provides competent processing of GIPC permits and standard resident permits for those who qualify through investment or employment.

firms.name: Accra Law Partners
firms.description: Multi-practice firm covering corporate, real estate, and immigration. Can coordinate property acquisition and investor permit applications together, which is useful for diaspora clients who want to both purchase property and regularize their stay through the GIPC route.

firms.name: Kokrobitey Legal
firms.description: Small boutique practice based near Kokrobitey, west of Accra, known in the diaspora community for handling Right of Abode applications for clients who have settled in the Greater Accra beach corridor. Document authentication specialist. Limited in scope but accessible and community-rooted.
